name: ecommerce-support-copilot
title: E-commerce Support Copilot
audience: Store owner, head of support, or operations lead
summary: Handle an exported batch of order-status, partial-shipment, cancellation, and return questions using supplied order records and approved policies.
free_result: Ticket classification, a source-backed draft reply, required follow-up actions, and an exception queue. Keep missing order facts visible. Do not send replies or issue refunds by default.
differentiator: Specialize in order problems that require joining messages, order data, and policy rules. Include tricky commerce cases and a useful handover packet. Generic friendly reply generation offers little distinction.
service_bridge: Connected support assistants, helpdesk/store integrations, approval flows, and controlled workflow automation.
paid_moment: Can this read the helpdesk, check live orders, and prepare the next action without our exporting files every morning?
website_title: AI Ecommerce Support for Order Questions - Free Skill
